# AI Code Reviewer

> A free, browser-based tool that provides instant AI-powered code reviews. Paste any code snippet and receive detailed feedback on bugs, performance, security, style, and best practices — powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash.

## What this site does

AI Code Reviewer lets developers submit code and receive a structured review from an AI acting as a senior engineer with 7+ years of experience. The review covers:

- Bug detection and logic errors
- Performance bottlenecks and optimisations
- Security vulnerabilities (XSS, injection, unsafe patterns)
- Code style, naming conventions, and formatting
- DRY / SOLID principle adherence
- Refactoring suggestions with improved code examples
- Documentation and test coverage advice

## Who it is for

Developers of all skill levels who want a fast second opinion on their code before shipping to production, during code review, or while learning a new language.

## Supported languages

JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, and any other language a large language model can understand.

## How to use it

1. Open https://code-reviewer-g.vercel.app/
2. Paste or type code into the left editor panel
3. Click "Review Code"
4. Read the structured AI review in the right panel

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19, Vite, react-simple-code-editor, PrismJS, react-markdown
- Backend: Node.js, Express, deployed on Vercel
- AI model: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash via @google/generative-ai SDK

## Pages
